trello.name: Fix Android Photo Upload Crash
trello.desc: Marcus to address the photo upload crash issue on Android 14, caused by a NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the app is backgrounded mid-upload. Steps to reproduce: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, then return. Aim to have the issue fixed and verified by QA by Wednesday. Sam to confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices once it's landed.

trello.name: Implement Offline Mode for Notes List
trello.desc: Elena will create the backend sync API allowing for offline notes access based on the client sending a last-synced timestamp and receiving a delta of notes changes. Marcus will handle the client-side, managing a local cache with Room, queuing writes offline, and replaying upon connectivity restoration. Acceptance criteria: App can function in airplane mode, display and edit notes, with changes syncing upon going online without data loss.

trello.name: Migrate CI Pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam is tasked with completing the migration of CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. This includes finishing the test and release pipelines, maintaining the nightly build schedule, and running both CI systems in parallel for a week to ensure stability before disabling Jenkins.

trello.name: Search Endpoint Rate Limiting
trello.desc: Elena to implement per-user rate limiting on the search endpoint to prevent service degradation from misbehaving scripts. Limit set to 100 requests per minute per user, returning HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header if exceeded. A metrics counter is also required to monitor rate limits.

trello.name: Update Consent Screen for GDPR Compliance
trello.desc: Marcus will update the privacy policy screen to meet GDPR compliance for the EU launch, replacing a single pre-checked consent box with separate opt-in toggles for analytics and marketing. This update is crucial for the August 20 release and is considered a launch blocker.

trello.name: Automated Coverage for Payments Flow
trello.desc: Sam to develop and implement automated regression tests for the payments flow, including purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation. These tests should be integrated into the CI pipeline using GitHub Actions to prevent future release issues.

trello.name: Backend Role Interviews and Sync API Review
trello.desc: Note for team awareness: Two candidates are currently being interviewed for an additional backend role. No immediate action required from the team. Additionally, Elena will be out on the 17th and 18th and aims to have the sync API reviewed before her absence. Teams should plan around her availability.
